-march=native -Wall -Wextra)\n\n# Link math library\ntarget_link_libraries(qtclustering m)\n// QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for     num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = Those\n//     candidate clusters are completely independent of each other, so one CUDA\n//     block grows the candidate cluster of one seed (blocks loop over seeds\n//     with a grid stride).\n//   * Inside a block, all threads cooperate on the O(N) \"find the unclustered\n//     point whose maximum distance to the current members is minimal\" scan and\n//     on the following block-wide argmin reduction.\n//   * The per-candidate maximum distance to the cluster members is carried\n//     incrementally (max over members == max of previous max and the distance\n//     to the newly added member), which is bit-identical to recomputing the\n//     full maximum, and points whose maximum distance has reached the\n//     threshold are dropped from the candidate list (the maximum is\n//     monotonically non-decreasing, so they can never become admissible\n//     again).\n//   * After a cluster has been committed, only seeds that have at least one of\n//     the newly clustered points within `threshold` can change their result;\n//     all other candidate clusters are provably identical to the previous\n//     iteration, so their cardinality is reused.\n//\n// All tie-breaking rules of the sequential code (smallest index wins) are\n// reproduced exactly, and all distance arithmetic is performed in double\n// precision with IEEE `sqrt`, so the produced clustering is identical.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                       \\\n        const cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                       \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                            \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__,   \\\n                    __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err__));                      \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                \\\n        }                                                                      \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Device code\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double devDistance(const double2 a, const double2 b) {\n    const double dx = a.x - b.x;\n    const double dy = a.y - b.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Block wide argmin over (value, index) with smallest-index tie-breaking.\n// Also publishes the number of surviving candidates of the pass and resets the\n// pass counter for the next pass.  Every thread of the block must call this.\ntemplate <int BS>\n__device__ __forceinline__ void finishPass(double val, int idx, double* s_warpVal,\n                                           int* s_warpIdx, int* s_cnt, int* s_len,\n                                           double* s_bestVal, int* s_bestIdx) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    constexpr int NWARPS = BS / 32;\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, val, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, idx, off);\n        if (ov < val || (ov == val && oi < idx)) {\n            val = ov;\n            idx = oi;\n        }\n    }\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        s_warpVal[warp] = val;\n        s_warpIdx[warp] = idx;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        double bv = s_warpVal[0];\n        int bi = s_warpIdx[0];\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int w = 1; w < NWARPS; ++w) {\n            const double ov = s_warpVal[w];\n            const int oi = s_warpIdx[w];\n            if (ov < bv || (ov == bv && oi < bi)) {\n                bv = ov;\n                bi = oi;\n            }\n        }\n        *s_bestVal = bv;\n        *s_bestIdx = bi;\n        *s_len = *s_cnt;\n        *s_cnt = 0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per seed.  `cardOut` is indexed by point id.\n// If `membersOut` is non-null (single seed / single block launch) the member\n// list of the grown cluster is written to it in insertion order.\ntemplate <int BS>\n__global__ void qtGrowClustersKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, const int N,\n                                     const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                     const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int numSeeds,\n                                     const double threshold,\n                                     int* __restrict__ cardOut,\n                                     int* __restrict__ idxScratch,\n                                     double* __restrict__ distScratch,\n                                     int* __restrict__ membersOut) {\n    __shared__ double s_warpVal[BS / 32];\n    __shared__ int s_warpIdx[BS / 32];\n    __shared__ int s_cnt;\n    __shared__ int s_len;\n    __shared__ double s_bestVal;\n    __shared__ int s_bestIdx;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * static_cast<size_t>(N) * 2;\n    int* const idxA = idxScratch + base;\n    int* const idxB = idxA + N;\n    double* const dstA = distScratch + base;\n    double* const dstB = dstA + N;\n\n    if (tid == 0) {\n        s_cnt = 0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int si = blockIdx.x; si < numSeeds; si += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[si];\n        const double2 seedP = pts[seed];\n\n        int* curI = idxA;\n        int* nxtI = idxB;\n        double* curD = dstA;\n        double* nxtD = dstB;\n\n        // First pass: all unclustered points within `threshold` of the seed are\n        // the only points that can ever join this candidate cluster.\n        double bv = 1.0e308;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n        for (int i = tid; i < N; i += BS) {\n            if (clustered[i] || i == seed) continue;\n            const double d = devDistance(pts[i], seedP);\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                const int p = atomicAdd(&s_cnt, 1);\n                nxtI[p] = i;\n                nxtD[p] = d;\n                if (d < bv || (d == bv && i < bi)) {\n                    bv = d;\n                    bi = i;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        finishPass<BS>(bv, bi, s_warpVal, s_warpIdx, &s_cnt, &s_len, &s_bestVal, &s_bestIdx);\n\n        int listLen = s_len;\n        int chosen = s_bestIdx;\n        int card = 1;\n        {\n            int* t = curI; curI = nxtI; nxtI = t;\n            double* u = curD; curD = nxtD; nxtD = u;\n        }\n\n        while (chosen != INT_MAX) {\n            if (membersOut != nullptr && tid == 0) {\n                membersOut[card] = chosen;\n            }\n            ++card;\n\n            const double2 newP = pts[chosen];\n            double pv = 1.0e308;\n            int pi = INT_MAX;\n            for (int j = tid; j < listLen; j += BS) {\n                const int idx = curI[j];\n                if (idx == chosen) continue;  // just became a member\n                double d = curD[j];\n                const double dn = devDistance(pts[idx], newP);\n                if (dn > d) d = dn;\n                if (d < threshold) {\n                    const int p = atomicAdd(&s_cnt, 1);\n                    nxtI[p] = idx;\n                    nxtD[p] = d;\n                    if (d < pv || (d == pv && idx < pi)) {\n                        pv = d;\n                        pi = idx;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            finishPass<BS>(pv, pi, s_warpVal, s_warpIdx, &s_cnt, &s_len, &s_bestVal, &s_bestIdx);\n\n            listLen = s_len;\n            chosen = s_bestIdx;\n            int* t = curI; curI = nxtI; nxtI = t;\n            double* u = curD; curD = nxtD; nxtD = u;\n        }\n\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            cardOut[seed] = card;\n            if (membersOut != nullptr) {\n                membersOut[0] = seed;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Mark all still unclustered points that have at least one of the freshly\n// clustered points within `threshold`; those are the seeds whose candidate\n// cluster has to be recomputed.  The surviving seeds are compacted into\n// `seedsOut`.\n__global__ void qtCollectDirtySeedsKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, const int N,\n                                          const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                          const int* __restrict__ newMembers,\n                                          const int newMemberCount,\n   for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < N;\n         i += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {\n        if (clustered[i]) continue;\n        const double2 p = pts[i];\n        bool dirty =     }\n        if (dirty) {\n            seedsOut[atomicAdd(seedCount, 1)] = i;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CeoZc25Gb6nMq5XUEMpRS","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QumZ4bEnBEfFHzjZnjE4pz","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/qtclustering_claude-opus-5-cc-medium_cuda_r4/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","old_string":"__device__ __forceinline__ double devDistance(const double2 a, const double2 b) {\n    const double dx = a.x - b.x;\n    const double dy = a.y - b.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}","new_string":"// Squared Euclidean distance.  All comparisons the algorithm performs on\n// distances (ordering of candidates and the threshold test) are monotone, so\n// they can be carried out on squared distances instead, which avoids a very\n// expensive double precision square root per candidate. * Inside a block, all threads cooperate on the O(N) \"find the unclustered\n//     point whose maximum distance to the current members is minimal\" scan and\n//     on the following block-wide argmin double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n si < numSeeds; si += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[si];\n        const double2 seedP = pts[seed];\n\n        int* curI = idxA;\n        int* nxtI = idxB;\n        double* curD = dstA;\n        double* nxtD = dstB;\n\n        // First pass: all unclustered points within `threshold` of the seed are\n        // the only points that can ever join this candidate cluster.\n        double bv = 1.0e308;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n        for (int i = tid; j < listLen; j += BS) {\n                const int idx = curI[j];\n                if (idx == chosen) continue;  // just became a member\n                double d = curD[j];\n                const double dn = devDistance(pts[idx], newP);\n                if (dn > d) d = dn;\n                if (d < threshold) {\n                    const int p = atomicAdd(&s_cnt, 1);\n                    nxtI[p] = idx;\n                    nxtD[p] = d;\n                    if (d < pv || (d == pv && idx < pi)) {\n                        pv = d;\n                        pi = idx;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            finishPass<BS>(pv, pi, s_warpVal, s_warpIdx, &s_cnt, &s_len, &s_bestVal, &s_bestIdx);\n\n            listLen = s_len;\n            chosen = s_bestIdx;\n            int* t = curI; double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n * Inside a block, all threads cooperate on the O(N) \"find the unclustered\n//     point whose maximum distance to the current members is minimal\" scan and\n//     on the following block-wide argmin Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call) double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n si < numSeeds; si += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[si];\n        const double2 seedP = pts[seed];\n\n        int* curI = idxA;\n        int* nxtI = idxB;\n        double* curD = dstA;\n        double* nxtD = dstB;\n\n        // First pass: all unclustered points within `threshold` of the seed are\n        // the only points that can ever join this candidate cluster.\n        double bv = 1.0e308;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n        for (int i = tid; i < N; i += BS) {\n            if (clustered[i] || i == seed) continue;\n            const double d = devDistanceSq(pts[i], seedP);\n            if (d < thresholdSq) {\n                const int p = atomicAdd(&s_cnt, 1);\n                nxtI[p] = i;\n                nxtD[p] = d;\n                if (d < bv || (d == bv && i < bi)) {\n                    bv = d;\n                    bi = i;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        finishPass<BS>(bv, bi, s_warpVal, s_warpIdx, &s_cnt, &s_len, &s_bestVal, &s_bestIdx);\n\n        int listLen = s_len;\n        int chosen = s_bestIdx;\n        int card = 1;\n        {\n            int* t = curI; s_len;\n            chosen = s_bestIdx;\n            int* t = curI; curI = nxtI; nxtI = t;\n            double* u = curD; curD = nxtD; nxtD = u;\n        }\n\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            cardOut[seed] = card;\n            if (membersOut != nullptr) {\n                membersOut[0] = seed;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Mark all still unclustered points that have at least one of the freshly\n// clustered points within `threshold`; those are the seeds whose candidate\n// cluster has to be recomputed.  The surviving seeds are compacted into\n// `seedsOut`.\n__global__ void qtCollectDirtySeedsKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, const int N,\n                                          const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                          const int* __restrict__ newMembers,\n                                          const int newMemberCount,\n                                          const double thresholdSq,\n                                          int* __restrict__ seedsOut,\n                                          int* __restrict__ seedCount) {\n    for (int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < N;\n         i += blockDim.x * gridDim.x) {\n        if (clustered[i]) continue;\n        const double2 p = pts[i];\n        bool dirty = false;\n        for (int k = 0; k < newMemberCount; ++k) {\n            if (devDistanceSq(p, pts[newMembers[k]]) < thresholdSq) {\n                dirty = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        if (dirty) {\n            seedsOut[atomicAdd(seedCount, 1)] = i;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host driver\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nnamespace {\n\n// Growing one candidate cluster is a long chain of short, dependent passes, so\n// the parallelism that matters is the number of resident blocks (= seeds in\n// flight).  With enough seeds, small blocks win; when only a handful of seeds\n// is left (in particular the single-block re-run that extracts the member list\n// of the winning cluster) wide blocks shorten the critical path instead.\nint chooseBlockSize(const int numSeeds) {\n    return (numSeeds >= 128) ? 64 : 256;\n}\n\nvoid launchGrow(const int blocks, const double2* pts, const int N,\n                const unsigned char* clustered, const int* seeds, const int numSeeds,\n                const double thresholdSq, int* cardOut, int* idxScratch,\n                double* distScratch, int* membersOut) {\n    if (chooseBlockSize(numSeeds) == 64) {\n        qtGrowClustersKernel<64><<<blocks, 64>>>(pts, N, clustered, seeds, numSeeds,\n                                                 thresholdSq, cardOut, idxScratch,\n                                                 distScratch, membersOut);\n    } else {\n        qtGrowClustersKernel<256><<<blocks, 256>>>(pts, N, clustered, seeds, numSeeds,\n                                                   thresholdSq, cardOut, idxScratch,\n                                                   distScratch, membersOut);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    // Exact squared-distance equivalent of the `dist < threshold` predicate.\n    const double thresholdSq = squaredThresholdCutoff(threshold);\n\n    // How many candidate clusters can we grow concurrently?  Every block needs\n    // two candidate lists (index + running maximum distance) of up to N entries.\n    const size_t perBlockBytes = static_cast<size_t>(N) * 2 * (sizeof(int) + sizeof(double));\n    size_t freeBytes = 0, totalBytes = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeBytes, &totalBytes));\n    const size_t pointBytes = static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double2);\n    const size_t fixedBytes = pointBytes + static_cast<size_t>(N) * (2 * sizeof(int) + 1) + 4096;\n    size_t budget = (freeBytes > fixedBytes) ? (freeBytes - fixedBytes) : 0;\n    budget = budget - budget / 5;  // leave some headroom\n    int maxBlocks = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(budget / perBlockBytes, 262144));\n    if (maxBlocks < 1) maxBlocks = 1;\n    if (maxBlocks > N) maxBlocks = N;\n\n    double2* d_points = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = nullptr;\n    int* d_seedCount = nullptr;\n    int* d_idxScratch = nullptr;\n    double* d_distScratch = nullptr;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_points, pointBytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_clustered, static_cast<size_t>(N)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_seeds, static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(int)));","numLines":210,"startLine":192,"totalLines":697}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CeobfyLQeoAn6QZFUCtor","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Done. `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` are the only files changed; the executable is still `qtclustering` and it always runs on the GPU.\n\n## Parallelization design\n\n**Where the parallelism is:** every outer iteration grows a candidate cluster for *each* still-unclustered seed, and those growths are fully independent → **one CUDA block per seed**, blocks grid-striding over the seed list. Inside a block all threads cooperate on the O(N) \"find the admissible point with minimal max-distance to the current members\" scan plus a warp-shuffle + shared-memory block argmin.\n\n**Algorithmic work reduction (all semantics-preserving):**\n- **Incremental max distance** — `max over members` is carried per candidate and updated with only the newly added member, instead of re-scanning all members (bit-identical, since `max` is exact selection). Cuts a factor of cluster-size.\n- **Candidate-list compaction** — the running max is monotonically non-decreasing, so a candidate that reaches the threshold can never become admissible again; each pass compacts survivors into a double-buffered list. The list starts as only the points within `threshold` of the seed, so passes scan a small list rather than all N.\n- **Dirty-seed tracking** — after committing a cluster, a seed's growth can only change if one of the newly clustered points was within `threshold` of it; all other cardinalities are provably unchanged and are reused. A small kernel computes and compacts the dirty seed set each iteration.\n- **Squared distances** — all distance comparisons are monotone, so they run on squared distances, removing an FP64 `sqrt` from the innermost loop (~1.5x). The threshold test uses a cutoff derived exactly with `nextafter`, so `d² < cutoff` is bit-for-bit the same predicate as `sqrt(d²) < threshold`.\n\n**Equivalence:** all arithmetic stays in double precision, and the argmin reduction is lexicographic on `(distance, index)`, which reproduces the sequential smallest-index tie-break and is order-independent, so results don't depend on block/thread count. Block size adapts (64 threads when many seeds are in flight for maximum resident-block parallelism; 256 for the single-block member-list extraction to shorten the critical path), and the number of concurrent blocks is sized from free device memory with an allocation-retry fallback.\n\n## Results (RTX 3090, warm clocks)\n\n| n | t | original | CUDA | speedup |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 1000 | 2.0 | 7014 ms | 11 ms | ~640x |\n| 500 | 30.0 | 47745 ms | 10 ms | ~4800x |\n| 65536 | 2.0 | — | 7.5 s | — |\n\nVerified byte-identical output (result hash, cluster count/sizes/seeds/diameters, `Validation: PASSED`) against the original sequential binary on 40+ configurations spanning n ∈ {31…4000} and t ∈ {0.13…30}, with zero mismatches. Two caveats worth stating: I stopped the comparison sweep before the slowest reference configs (n ≥ 900 with t = 25, n ≥ 1000 with large t) finished, since the sequential version needs hours there — those sizes were covered at other thresholds instead. Inside a block all threads cooperate on the O(N) \"find the admissible point with minimal max-distance to the current members\" scan plus a warp-shuffle + shared-memory block argmin.\n\n**Algorithmic work reduction (all semantics-preserving):**\n- **Incremental max distance** — `max over members` is carried per candidate and updated with only the newly added member, instead of re-scanning all members (bit-identical, since `max` is exact selection). Cuts a factor of cluster-size.\n- **Candidate-list compaction** — the running max is monotonically non-decreasing, so a candidate that reaches the threshold can never become admissible again; each pass compacts survivors into a double-buffered list. The list starts as only the points within `threshold` of the seed, so passes scan a small list rather than all N.\n- **Dirty-seed tracking** — after committing a cluster, a seed's growth can only change if one of the newly clustered points was within `threshold` of it; all other cardinalities are provably unchanged and are reused. A small kernel computes and compacts the dirty seed set each iteration.\n- **Squared distances** — all distance comparisons are monotone, so they run on squared distances, removing an FP64 `sqrt` from the innermost loop (~1.5x). The threshold test uses a cutoff derived exactly with `nextafter`, so `d² < cutoff` is bit-for-bit the same predicate as `sqrt(d²) < threshold`.\n\n**Equivalence:** all arithmetic stays in double precision, and the argmin reduction is lexicographic on `(distance, index)`, which reproduces the sequential smallest-index tie-break and is order-independent, so results don't depend on block/thread count. Block size adapts (64 threads when many seeds are in flight for maximum resident-block parallelism; 256 for the single-block member-list extraction to shorten the critical path), and the number of concurrent blocks is sized from free device memory with an allocation-retry fallback.\n\n## Results (RTX 3090, warm clocks)\n\n| n | t | original | CUDA | speedup |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 1000 | 2.0 | 7014 ms | 11 ms | ~640x |\n| 500 | 30.0 | 47745 ms | 10 ms | ~4800x |\n| 65536 | 2.0 | — | 7.5 s | — |\n\nVerified byte-identical output (result hash, cluster count/sizes/seeds/diameters, `Validation: PASSED`) against the original sequential binary on 40+ configurations spanning n ∈ {31…4000} and t ∈ {0.13…30}, with zero mismatches.
